newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury moves 52-wk bill sale to March 26.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury moves 52-wk bill sale to March 26.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will auction 52-week bills on March 26, rather than on March 27 as it had announced on a tentative schedule issued last month.
A Treasury official said the change was made partly because markets are expected to close early on March 27, the day before Good Friday and the Easter holiday weekend.
Details including the amount of 52-week bills to be sold will be announced on March 21.
